title: Langton
description: Multiple phases of a Romano-British villa were excavated at Langton, East Riding, Yorkshire, England. The site was discovered in 1899 and excavations took place in 1926 and 1930-31. The original phase of the site might have been either a military outpost or an indigenous farmstead.
